verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents programmatic API access through service accounts and supports dashboards as code. Its MCP server and Agent Skills let agents query traces, logs and metrics, create and modify dashboards, and manage alerts and saved views, so much of the UI surface is reachable programmatically. However, nothing states full API/UI parity, and the OpenAPI probe found no public spec. Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity guarantee, a published OpenAPI/API reference covering all UI features (e.g. log pipelines, public dashboard publishing, IAM roles), and independent corroboration of API completeness.
